requirements.quote:
To correctly implement congestion control, a QUIC sender tracks every
   ack-eliciting packet until the packet is acknowledged or lost.
requirements.condition: For every ack-eliciting packet sent by a QUIC sender.
requirements.required_behavior: Retain tracking state for the packet until it is acknowledged or declared lost.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Discard tracking state for the packet before either acknowledgment or loss declaration.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can send an ack-eliciting packet and inspect whether its state remains available through the acknowledgment-or-loss terminal event.

requirements.quote:
It is
   expected that implementations will be able to access this information
   by packet number and crypto context
requirements.condition: When loss-recovery or congestion-control logic looks up tracked sent-packet information.
requirements.required_behavior: Make the information addressable by packet number and crypto context.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Use a lookup scheme that cannot distinguish the required packet-number and crypto-context combination.
requirements.why_checkable: Static inspection or lookup tests can verify that both packet number and crypto context identify tracked packet state.

requirements.quote:
store the per-packet fields
   (Appendix A.1.1) for loss recovery and congestion control.
requirements.condition: When tracking a sent packet for loss recovery and congestion control.
requirements.required_behavior: Store the per-packet fields described in Appendix A.1.1.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Omit required per-packet state needed by loss recovery or congestion control.
requirements.why_checkable: The packet record layout and values populated on send can be inspected directly.

requirements.quote:
After a packet is declared lost, the endpoint can still maintain
   state for it for an amount of time to allow for packet reordering;
requirements.condition: After a packet has been declared lost.
requirements.required_behavior: No mandatory behavior is stated; retaining state for a reordering interval is permitted.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: None; the statement is permissive.
requirements.why_checkable: State retention can be observed, but the text uses permissive language and gives no required duration in this chunk.

requirements.quote: Sent packets are tracked for each packet number space
requirements.condition: While maintaining sent-packet tracking state.
requirements.required_behavior: Maintain sent-packet tracking separately for each packet number space.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Collapse sent packets from distinct packet number spaces into undifferentiated tracking state.
requirements.why_checkable: Tests can reuse a packet number in different spaces and verify that independent records are maintained.

requirements.quote:
ACK
   processing only applies to a single space.
requirements.condition: When processing an ACK.
requirements.required_behavior: Apply ACK processing only within one packet number space.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Use an ACK in one packet number space to acknowledge or update packets in another space.
requirements.why_checkable: A cross-space ACK test can verify that only records in the ACK's packet number space change.

requirements.quote: packet_number:  The packet number of the sent packet.
requirements.condition: For a stored sent-packet record.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent the packet number of that sent packet in the packet_number field.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Associate the record with a different packet number.
requirements.why_checkable: The stored field can be compared directly with the packet number supplied on send.

requirements.quote:
ack_eliciting:  A Boolean that indicates whether a packet is ack-
      eliciting.
requirements.condition: For a stored sent-packet record.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent whether the packet is ack-eliciting as a Boolean ack_eliciting field.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Store an ack_eliciting value inconsistent with the packet's ack-eliciting status.
requirements.why_checkable: Packet construction and stored state can be compared for both Boolean cases.

requirements.quote:
If true, it is expected that an acknowledgment will be
      received, though the peer could delay sending the ACK frame
      containing it by up to the max_ack_delay.
requirements.condition: When a sent packet's ack_eliciting field is true.
requirements.required_behavior: No deterministic local implementation behavior is stated; the text describes an expectation about peer acknowledgment timing.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: None stated.
requirements.why_checkable: Peer acknowledgments can be observed, but loss and the permissive wording prevent this statement from defining a mandatory local check.

requirements.quote:
in_flight:  A Boolean that indicates whether the packet counts toward
      bytes in flight.
requirements.condition: For a stored sent-packet record.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent whether the packet counts toward bytes in flight as a Boolean in_flight field.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Store an in_flight value inconsistent with whether the packet counts toward bytes in flight.
requirements.why_checkable: Tests can compare packet accounting status with the stored Boolean.

requirements.quote:
sent_bytes:  The number of bytes sent in the packet, not including
      UDP or IP overhead
requirements.condition: When computing sent_bytes for a sent packet.
requirements.required_behavior: Exclude UDP and IP overhead from sent_bytes.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Count UDP or IP overhead in sent_bytes.
requirements.why_checkable: A packet with known transport and network-layer sizes yields an exact expected byte count.

requirements.quote: but including QUIC framing overhead.
requirements.condition: When computing sent_bytes for a sent packet.
requirements.required_behavior: Include QUIC framing overhead in sent_bytes.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Exclude QUIC framing overhead from sent_bytes.
requirements.why_checkable: A packet with known QUIC framing overhead yields an exact expected byte count.

requirements.quote: time_sent:  The time the packet was sent.
requirements.condition: For a stored sent-packet record.
requirements.required_behavior: Record the time at which the packet was sent in time_sent.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Populate time_sent with an unrelated event time.
requirements.why_checkable: A controlled clock can verify that the stored timestamp corresponds to the send event.

requirements.quote:
kPacketThreshold:  Maximum reordering in packets before packet
      threshold loss detection considers a packet lost.
requirements.condition: When performing packet-threshold loss detection.
requirements.required_behavior: Use kPacketThreshold as the maximum packet-count reordering tolerated before considering a packet lost.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Interpret kPacketThreshold as a time threshold or an unrelated counter.
requirements.why_checkable: Packet-number gaps around the configured threshold can verify the threshold's operational meaning.

requirements.quote:
The value
      recommended in Section 6.1.1 is 3.
requirements.condition: When selecting the recommended kPacketThreshold value.
requirements.required_behavior: Use 3 as the recommended kPacketThreshold value.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Claim conformance to this recommendation while using a different value.
requirements.why_checkable: The configured constant and boundary behavior can be inspected directly.

requirements.quote:
kTimeThreshold:  Maximum reordering in time before time threshold
      loss detection considers a packet lost.
requirements.condition: When performing time-threshold loss detection.
requirements.required_behavior: Use kTimeThreshold as the maximum time reordering tolerated before considering a packet lost.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Interpret kTimeThreshold as a packet-count threshold or unrelated duration.
requirements.why_checkable: Controlled send and acknowledgment times can exercise loss decisions on both sides of the threshold.

requirements.quote:
Specified as an RTT
      multiplier.
requirements.condition: When representing and applying kTimeThreshold.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent and apply kTimeThreshold as an RTT multiplier.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Treat kTimeThreshold as an absolute duration independent of RTT.
requirements.why_checkable: Varying RTT while holding the multiplier fixed can verify proportional threshold behavior.

requirements.quote: The value recommended in Section 6.1.2 is 9/8.
requirements.condition: When selecting the recommended kTimeThreshold value.
requirements.required_behavior: Use 9/8 as the recommended RTT multiplier.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Claim conformance to this recommendation while using a different multiplier.
requirements.why_checkable: The configured multiplier or resulting threshold can be compared with 9/8.

requirements.quote: kGranularity:  Timer granularity.  This is a system-dependent value
requirements.condition: When representing timer granularity for loss recovery.
requirements.required_behavior: Use kGranularity for timer granularity and permit its value to depend on the system.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Interpret kGranularity as a quantity unrelated to timer resolution.
requirements.why_checkable: The timer implementation and configured value can be inspected for correspondence with system timer resolution.

requirements.quote: Section 6.1.2 recommends a value of 1 ms.
requirements.condition: When selecting the recommended kGranularity value.
requirements.required_behavior: Use 1 ms as the recommended timer granularity.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Claim conformance to this recommendation while using a different value.
requirements.why_checkable: The configured timer granularity can be compared directly with 1 ms.

requirements.quote: kInitialRtt:  The RTT used before an RTT sample is taken.
requirements.condition: Before the first RTT sample has been taken.
requirements.required_behavior: Use kInitialRtt as the RTT value.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Use a measured RTT value before any RTT sample exists.
requirements.why_checkable: Loss-recovery timing before the first RTT sample can be compared with kInitialRtt-based calculations.

requirements.quote:
The value
      recommended in Section 6.2.2 is 333 ms.
requirements.condition: When selecting the recommended kInitialRtt value.
requirements.required_behavior: Use 333 ms as the recommended initial RTT.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Claim conformance to this recommendation while using a different initial RTT.
requirements.why_checkable: The initial constant or pre-sample timing behavior can be compared directly with 333 ms.

requirements.quote:
kPacketNumberSpace:  An enum to enumerate the three packet number
      spaces:

   enum kPacketNumberSpace {
     Initial,
     Handshake,
     ApplicationData,
   }
requirements.condition: When enumerating QUIC packet number spaces for loss recovery state.
requirements.required_behavior: Provide exactly the Initial, Handshake, and ApplicationData packet number space categories.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Omit one of the three categories or conflate distinct packet number spaces.
requirements.why_checkable: The enum or equivalent discriminated state can be inspected for the three named spaces.

requirements.quote:
latest_rtt:  The most recent RTT measurement made when receiving an
      acknowledgment for a previously unacknowledged packet.
requirements.condition: After receiving an acknowledgment for a previously unacknowledged packet.
requirements.required_behavior: Make latest_rtt equal to the most recent RTT measurement produced by such an acknowledgment.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Leave latest_rtt representing an older qualifying measurement after a newer one is made.
requirements.why_checkable: A sequence of acknowledgments with controlled timings can verify which RTT sample is retained.

requirements.quote:
smoothed_rtt:  The smoothed RTT of the connection, computed as
      described in Section 5.3.
requirements.condition: When maintaining the connection's smoothed RTT.
requirements.required_behavior: Compute smoothed_rtt using the method described in Section 5.3.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Populate smoothed_rtt using a calculation inconsistent with Section 5.3.
requirements.why_checkable: Given an RTT sample sequence, the implementation's stored result can be compared with the referenced algorithm.

requirements.quote: rttvar:  The RTT variation, computed as described in Section 5.3.
requirements.condition: When maintaining RTT variation.
requirements.required_behavior: Compute rttvar using the method described in Section 5.3.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Populate rttvar using a calculation inconsistent with Section 5.3.
requirements.why_checkable: Given an RTT sample sequence, the stored variation can be compared with the referenced algorithm.

requirements.quote:
min_rtt:  The minimum RTT seen over a period of time, ignoring
      acknowledgment delay, as described in Section 5.2.
requirements.condition: When maintaining the minimum RTT over the relevant period.
requirements.required_behavior: Store the minimum observed RTT while ignoring acknowledgment delay, according to Section 5.2.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Include acknowledgment delay in a way that changes the minimum RTT definition.
requirements.why_checkable: Controlled RTT samples and acknowledgment delays can verify the stored minimum.

requirements.quote: first_rtt_sample:  The time that the first RTT sample was obtained.
requirements.condition: Once the first RTT sample has been obtained.
requirements.required_behavior: Store the time that first sample was obtained in first_rtt_sample.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Replace first_rtt_sample with the acquisition time of a later RTT sample.
requirements.why_checkable: A controlled clock and multiple RTT samples can verify that the first acquisition time is retained.

requirements.quote:
max_ack_delay:  The maximum amount of time by which the receiver
      intends to delay acknowledgments for packets in the Application
      Data packet number space, as defined by the eponymous transport
      parameter (Section 18.2 of [QUIC-TRANSPORT]).
requirements.condition: When representing the peer's intended maximum acknowledgment delay.
requirements.required_behavior: Derive max_ack_delay from the corresponding transport parameter and apply its meaning to Application Data packet acknowledgments.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Treat max_ack_delay as an intended delay bound for a different packet number space.
requirements.why_checkable: Transport-parameter inputs and packet-number-space-specific timer calculations can be inspected.

requirements.quote:
the
      actual ack_delay in a received ACK frame may be larger due to late
      timers, reordering, or loss.
requirements.condition: When a received ACK frame reports ack_delay greater than max_ack_delay.
requirements.required_behavior: No specific handling behavior is stated; the implementation is cautioned that this value can occur.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: None expressly stated.
requirements.error_behavior: No rejection, clamping, or other error response is specified by this text.
requirements.why_checkable: The input condition can be generated, but the note does not define a required response to test.

requirements.quote: loss_detection_timer:  Multi-modal timer used for loss detection.
requirements.condition: When implementing loss detection timing.
requirements.required_behavior: Maintain a timer capable of the loss-detection modes required elsewhere.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: None precisely stated in this line.
requirements.why_checkable: A timer is observable, but the required modes and their behavior are not defined in this chunk.

requirements.quote:
pto_count:  The number of times a PTO has been sent without receiving
      an acknowledgment.
requirements.condition: While PTO transmissions remain unacknowledged.
requirements.required_behavior: Make pto_count equal the number of PTOs sent without receipt of an acknowledgment.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Report a count inconsistent with the unacknowledged PTO transmissions.
requirements.why_checkable: Tests can send successive PTOs without ACKs and compare the observed counter after each send.

requirements.quote:
time_of_last_ack_eliciting_packet[kPacketNumberSpace]:  The time the
      most recent ack-eliciting packet was sent.
requirements.condition: For each packet number space after an ack-eliciting packet is sent in that space.
requirements.required_behavior: Store the send time of that space's most recent ack-eliciting packet.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Use a packet from another space or a non-ack-eliciting packet to define the value.
requirements.why_checkable: Interleaved sends across spaces and packet types can verify the per-space last-send timestamp.

requirements.quote:
largest_acked_packet[kPacketNumberSpace]:  The largest packet number
      acknowledged in the packet number space so far.
requirements.condition: For each packet number space after processing acknowledgments in that space.
requirements.required_behavior: Store the largest packet number acknowledged so far in that packet number space.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Reduce the value or derive it from acknowledgments in another packet number space.
requirements.why_checkable: Out-of-order acknowledgments in multiple spaces can verify monotonic per-space state.

requirements.quote:
loss_time[kPacketNumberSpace]:  The time at which the next packet in
      that packet number space can be considered lost based on exceeding
      the reordering window in time.
requirements.condition: When a packet in a packet number space is awaiting time-threshold loss determination.
requirements.required_behavior: Store, per packet number space, the next time at which a packet can be considered lost for exceeding the time reordering window.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Use a cross-space or non-time-threshold event as that space's loss_time.
requirements.why_checkable: Known send times and reordering thresholds yield a calculable next loss time for each space.

requirements.quote:
sent_packets[kPacketNumberSpace]:  An association of packet numbers
      in a packet number space to information about them.
requirements.condition: When maintaining sent-packet information.
requirements.required_behavior: Associate packet numbers with their packet information separately within each packet number space.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Allow identical packet numbers in different spaces to overwrite or alias one another's information.
requirements.why_checkable: Records for the same numeric packet number in different spaces can be inserted and retrieved independently.

requirements.quote:
At the beginning of the connection, initialize the loss detection
   variables as follows:

   loss_detection_timer.reset()
requirements.condition: At the beginning of a connection.
requirements.required_behavior: Reset loss_detection_timer.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Carry an armed or expired loss-detection timer state into the new connection.
requirements.why_checkable: New-connection initialization can be observed to ensure no timer remains scheduled from prior state.

requirements.quote: pto_count = 0
requirements.condition: At the beginning of a connection.
requirements.required_behavior: Initialize pto_count to 0.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Begin the connection with a nonzero PTO count.
requirements.why_checkable: The initial counter value can be inspected directly.

requirements.quote: latest_rtt = 0
requirements.condition: At the beginning of a connection.
requirements.required_behavior: Initialize latest_rtt to 0.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Carry a prior or fabricated RTT measurement into latest_rtt.
requirements.why_checkable: The initial variable value can be inspected directly.

requirements.quote: smoothed_rtt = kInitialRtt
requirements.condition: At the beginning of a connection.
requirements.required_behavior: Initialize smoothed_rtt to kInitialRtt.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Initialize smoothed_rtt to a different value.
requirements.why_checkable: The initial variable value can be compared directly with kInitialRtt.

requirements.quote: rttvar = kInitialRtt / 2
requirements.condition: At the beginning of a connection.
requirements.required_behavior: Initialize rttvar to one half of kInitialRtt.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Initialize rttvar to a value other than kInitialRtt divided by 2.
requirements.why_checkable: The initial variable value can be compared with the configured kInitialRtt divided by two.

requirements.quote: min_rtt = 0
requirements.condition: At the beginning of a connection.
requirements.required_behavior: Initialize min_rtt to 0.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Carry a previous connection's minimum RTT into the new connection.
requirements.why_checkable: The initial variable value can be inspected directly.

requirements.quote: first_rtt_sample = 0
requirements.condition: At the beginning of a connection.
requirements.required_behavior: Initialize first_rtt_sample to 0.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Begin with a nonzero first RTT sample timestamp.
requirements.why_checkable: The initial variable value can be inspected directly.

requirements.quote:
for pn_space in [ Initial, Handshake, ApplicationData ]:
     largest_acked_packet[pn_space] = infinite
requirements.condition: At the beginning of a connection, for each of Initial, Handshake, and ApplicationData.
requirements.required_behavior: Initialize largest_acked_packet for the packet number space to infinite.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Leave any of the three packet number spaces with another initial largest_acked_packet value.
requirements.why_checkable: The initial per-space array entries can be inspected directly.

requirements.condition: At the beginning of a connection, for each of Initial, Handshake, and ApplicationData.
requirements.required_behavior: Initialize time_of_last_ack_eliciting_packet for the packet number space to 0.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Leave any of the three packet number spaces with a nonzero initial last ack-eliciting send time.
requirements.why_checkable: The initial per-space array entries can be inspected directly.

requirements.quote:
for pn_space in [ Initial, Handshake, ApplicationData ]:
     largest_acked_packet[pn_space] = infinite
     time_of_last_ack_eliciting_packet[pn_space] = 0
     loss_time[pn_space] = 0
requirements.condition: At the beginning of a connection, for each of Initial, Handshake, and ApplicationData.
requirements.required_behavior: Initialize loss_time for the packet number space to 0.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Leave any of the three packet number spaces with a nonzero initial loss_time.
requirements.why_checkable: The initial per-space array entries can be inspected directly.

requirements.quote:
sent_packets[pn_space][packet_number].packet_number =
                                             packet_number
requirements.condition: When OnPacketSent is called for packet_number in pn_space.
requirements.required_behavior: Set that sent-packet record's packet_number field to the packet_number argument.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Store a different packet number in the record.
requirements.why_checkable: Calling OnPacketSent with a known packet number yields a directly inspectable record field.

requirements.quote: sent_packets[pn_space][packet_number].time_sent = now()
requirements.condition: When OnPacketSent is called for packet_number in pn_space.
requirements.required_behavior: Set that sent-packet record's time_sent field to the current time.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Leave time_sent unset or use an unrelated timestamp.
requirements.why_checkable: A controlled clock makes the expected stored timestamp deterministic.

requirements.quote:
sent_packets[pn_space][packet_number].ack_eliciting =
                                             ack_eliciting
requirements.condition: When OnPacketSent is called for packet_number in pn_space.
requirements.required_behavior: Set that sent-packet record's ack_eliciting field to the ack_eliciting argument.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Store an ack_eliciting value different from the argument.
requirements.why_checkable: Calls with both Boolean values yield directly inspectable record fields.

requirements.quote: sent_packets[pn_space][packet_number].in_flight = in_flight
requirements.condition: When OnPacketSent is called for packet_number in pn_space.
requirements.required_behavior: Set that sent-packet record's in_flight field to the in_flight argument.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Store an in_flight value different from the argument.
requirements.why_checkable: Calls with both Boolean values yield directly inspectable record fields.

requirements.quote: sent_packets[pn_space][packet_number].sent_bytes = sent_bytes
requirements.condition: When OnPacketSent is called for packet_number in pn_space.
requirements.required_behavior: Set that sent-packet record's sent_bytes field to the sent_bytes argument.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Store a sent_bytes value different from the argument.
requirements.why_checkable: A call with a known byte count yields a directly inspectable record field.

requirements.condition: When OnPacketSent is called with both in_flight and ack_eliciting true.
requirements.required_behavior: Set time_of_last_ack_eliciting_packet for pn_space to the current time.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Perform this update for a packet that is not in flight or is not ack-eliciting.
requirements.why_checkable: A controlled clock and all four Boolean combinations can verify the guarded update.

requirements.condition: When OnPacketSent is called with in_flight true.
requirements.required_behavior: Invoke OnPacketSentCC with sent_bytes.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Invoke OnPacketSentCC for a packet whose in_flight argument is false.
requirements.why_checkable: Instrumentation can verify the call and argument for in-flight and non-in-flight packets.

requirements.condition: When OnPacketSent is called with in_flight true.
requirements.required_behavior: Invoke SetLossDetectionTimer after recording and congestion-control handling of the sent packet.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Invoke SetLossDetectionTimer through this path for a packet whose in_flight argument is false.
requirements.why_checkable: Instrumentation can verify timer re-evaluation and its guard after each OnPacketSent call.

requirements.quote:
When a server is blocked by anti-amplification limits, receiving a
   datagram unblocks it, even if none of the packets in the datagram are
   successfully processed.
requirements.condition: When a server blocked by anti-amplification limits receives a datagram.
requirements.required_behavior: Unblock the server based on receipt of the datagram even if none of its packets are successfully processed.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Keep the server blocked solely because every packet in the received datagram failed processing.
requirements.error_behavior: Packet-processing failures do not prevent the receipt from unblocking the server.
requirements.why_checkable: A server can be put at the amplification limit and given a datagram containing only unprocessable packets to observe whether sending becomes unblocked.

requirements.quote:
In such a case, the PTO timer will need to
   be rearmed.
requirements.condition: When receipt of a datagram unblocks a server that was blocked by anti-amplification limits.
requirements.required_behavior: Rearm the PTO timer.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Leave the PTO timer disarmed after the server becomes unblocked in this case.
requirements.error_behavior: Rearm the timer even when no packet in the datagram was successfully processed.
requirements.why_checkable: A blocked server and wholly unprocessable datagram provide a focused test of the timer's post-receipt state.
